verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable at https://docs.x.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key). This alongside an llms.txt index of the REST documentation, which directly delivers the story. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing or linking the spec, and verification of how much of the API (text, image, video, speech endpoints) it covers.
